## Objective
Close the trust gap found in the OLI-17 specimen: a manifest run whose Beislid artifact declared pre-PR gates and proof requirements got a clean_eval pass with zero gates executed.

## Design summary
- Thread the manifest source_contract.process_provider artifact context into clean_eval's gate selection: clean_eval.ex already builds selections at stage :pre_pr (L261 gates_override path, L282 gate_selection_opts) - ensure the provider artifact path used during the run reaches these selections for manifest runs, so declared pre_pr gates are selected and executed during clean eval.
- Fail closed: when the artifact declares gate sets or proof requirements and clean_eval executes none of them, the result must not be status pass. Emit status fail with reason "declared_proofs_not_executed" (add a reason field to rondo.clean_eval/v0 output if absent). A pass requires: patch applied AND every selected declared gate executed and green.
- Keep command_proofs handling consistent with the shape in process_provider/native.ex - read it first.
- Tests: manifest fixture with declared pre_pr gates -> clean_eval executes them (gate logs present in clean_eval/gates/); declared-but-unexecutable -> fail with the reason; no declarations -> current behavior unchanged.

## File scope
Include: elixir/lib/rondo/clean_eval.ex, elixir/lib/rondo/process_provider/native.ex (only as needed for proof shape), elixir/test/rondo/clean_eval_test.exs. Exclude: turn-loop and run-decision changes (separate slices RON-159/RON-161).

## Constraints
Do not weaken any currently-failing path into a pass. No remote writes.

## Verification
cd elixir && mix test test/rondo/clean_eval_test.exs
cd elixir && mix format --check-formatted && mix credo --strict && mix test
